summary:
Frontend-only verification of Chaser Phase 3 (Spray tab restructure + Save-as-Planned + Home greeting). Fresh @gmail.com signup + migration on live Supabase project via web preview, mobile viewport 390x844.

PASSING scenarios:
(1) HOME GREETING — PASS. Header renders exactly as spec: greeting-time='Good Evening' (time-of-day computed on mount, correct for test-run wall clock), greeting-name='You (Manager)' (from repo.operators.defaultUser() — the seeded is_default_user=true operator resolves correctly), prompt 'What are we chasing today?' in green italic below the name, brand-name='Chaser' bold on the right, brand-tagline='Behind every good operation' italic under it. All 4 required testIDs (greeting-time, greeting-name, brand-name, brand-tagline) present and correct.
(2) SPRAY TAB LAYOUT (empty state, no active) — PASS. Top-right 'New Job' button (testID=new-job-btn) present. Subtitle correctly shows '0 planned · 0 in progress · 2 recent'. Sections rendered in the exact required order: PLANNED (with 'No planned jobs. Tap New Job to plan or start one.' empty-state Card) → RECENTLY COMPLETED (2 seeded jobs 'North 40' / 'South Ridge' + 'See all →' link testID=see-all-completed-btn routing to /records) → TOOLS (5 calculator cards: records, spray-rate, tank-mix, nozzle, delta-t — matches spec).
(3) SPRAY TAB LAYOUT (with active job) — PASS. After Start Job the tab correctly shows the IN PROGRESS section ABOVE the PLANNED section with testID=active-job-card (left-border warning colour), inline meta ('North 40 · Wheat · 42 ha · You (Manager) · Started HH:MM'), a StatusBadge ('Due Soon'), and a full-width 'COMPLETE JOB' button (testID=active-complete-btn). Subtitle updates to '0 planned · 1 in progress · 2 recent'.
(4) START JOB STILL WORKS — PASS. Filled required fields (farm chip → Home Block, paddock chip → North 40, operator was auto-defaulted to 'You (Manager) · you' via is_default_user, machinery chip → Big Rig auto-filled water_rate/speed/boom/nozzle/spacing, added Roundup PowerMAX product via picker). Tapped start-job-btn → URL router.replace to /active-job/<uuid> → Active Spray Job screen renders correctly with LIVE elapsed timer, tank mix (Roundup PowerMAX 1.5 L/ha · Total 63.00 L), starting weather (16.4°C / 49% / 5.9 DT / 10 km/h ENE), GPS coords -35.1170,147.3560.

============================================================
CRITICAL BUG — SAVE AS PLANNED CRASHES THE APP (red screen)
============================================================
Reproduced twice with fresh accounts.
Steps: New Job → fill farm/paddock/operator/machinery/product → tap save-planned-btn.
Expected: job saved with status='planned', router.replace('/spray'), planned card visible with PLANNED badge.
Actual: navigation attempted; the Spray tab component re-mounts and the ErrorBoundary renders 'Something went wrong · Please reload the app to continue · cannot add `postgres_changes` callbacks for realtime:rt-spray_jobs_spray_job_products-<uuid> after `subscribe()`.' URL ends up at '/' (root). Planned card never renders. Console error also captured: `[ErrorBoundary] render crash: Error: cannot add postgres_changes callbacks for realtime:rt-spray_jobs_spray_job_products-<uuid> after subscribe().  at RealtimeChannel.on ... at SprayHub (./(tabs)/spray.tsx)`.

Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/realtime.ts:37 builds a deterministic channel name `rt-${tables.join('_')}-${businessId}`. Supabase JS realtime client caches channels by topic. On the second Spray-tab mount (triggered by router.replace('/spray') from records/new after savePlanned), the cleanup `supabase.removeChannel(channel)` from the previous mount has not yet completed / the SDK still holds the already-subscribed channel in its `.channels[]` list. `supabase.channel(sameName)` returns the CACHED already-subscribed channel; the next `channel.on('postgres_changes', ...)` call fails because the realtime SDK forbids adding listeners after subscribe. This blows the useEffect body and the ErrorBoundary swallows the whole Spray tree. Start Job does NOT crash because router.replace('/active-job/[id]') doesn't re-mount SprayHub.

Because save-planned crashes before persistence completes reliably, the following spec scenarios are BLOCKED and could NOT be verified end-to-end this iteration:
- PLANNED TAP-THROUGH (routes to /records/new?plannedId=... without crash) — could not verify because no planned card was rendered.
- COMPLETE JOB from IN PROGRESS card via active-complete-btn (route → active-job screen → Complete flow → returns → job appears in Recently Completed) — button/route wired correctly (verified in another path — tapping active-complete-btn routes to /active-job/<id>), but the end-to-end Complete-return flow was not run because of time budget.
- REALTIME cross-tab (Tab B updates within 2s) — cannot verify while single-tab realtime itself crashes.

(5) REGRESSION — signup + migration (12 tables / 38 records) works, tab bar Home/Paddocks/Spray/Machinery/More renders, Home weather card / service reminders / recent records all render, Chemical picker + APVMA fallback still work, operator/machinery/paddock chip auto-fill still works, default operator resolution works.

Deprecated packages detected: none. No SafeAreaView issues. No red screens except the one caused by the realtime bug above.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Save-as-Planned button navigates to /spray via router.replace, which re-mounts SprayHub. useRealtime attempts to re-attach postgres_changes listeners to a channel that Supabase still has cached in a subscribed state, throwing 'cannot add postgres_changes callbacks... after subscribe()'. ErrorBoundary swallows the whole Spray tab. Reproducible 100% on both a first-time save-planned and a save-planned after an active job already exists.

integration_issues.flow: Save as Planned → Spray tab realtime resubscribe
integration_issues.issue: Deterministic channel name `rt-${tables.join('_')}-${businessId}` in src/lib/realtime.ts:37 collides with a cached-and-already-subscribed channel on the second mount. The .on() call in the same tick then throws. Same risk exists on every screen that uses useRealtime whenever it is unmounted and immediately remounted (e.g. any router.replace back to a tab).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix useRealtime channel-name collision in /app/frontend/src/lib/realtime.ts. Recommended fix: append a per-mount random suffix so each mount subscribes to its own channel — e.g. inside the effect: `const channel = supabase.channel(`rt-${tables.join('_')}-${businessId}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,10)}`);`. Alternatively, `await supabase.removeChannel(channel)` in cleanup and gate the .on() calls behind a channel.state check, or memoise the channel with useRef and only recreate it when tables/businessId actually change (not on every callback change). After the fix, re-verify Save-as-Planned end-to-end.
AFTER FIX: Re-run PLANNED TAP-THROUGH (planned card → /records/new?plannedId=<id> should open without crash and no prefill — that limitation is expected per PRD).
AFTER FIX: Re-run full COMPLETE JOB round-trip (In Progress card → active-complete-btn → Active Spray Job → Complete → return → verify moved to Recently Completed and IN PROGRESS section removed).
AFTER FIX: Verify realtime cross-tab (two browser contexts as same owner: save-planned in A → Planned section in B updates within ~2s).
LOW: Consider surfacing a Snackbar/toast confirmation ('Planned job saved') after successful save-planned so the user has feedback beyond the section update.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/realtime.ts:37 — deterministic channel name is the direct cause of the crash; supabase-js caches channels by topic and disallows .on() after subscribe(). Every screen using useRealtime is vulnerable when the tree is remounted quickly.

app/(tabs)/spray.tsx:39 — `useRealtime(['spray_jobs','spray_job_products'], load, [load])` deps are stable (load is a useCallback with []), so the effect only re-runs on mount/unmount, but the router.replace('/spray') from records/new does re-mount SprayHub in the tabs stack and triggers the collision.

app/records/new.tsx:305 — savePlanned uses router.replace('/spray'). Consider router.back() (which does NOT remount) or router.dismissAll() + navigate, to avoid remounting the tab; this would sidestep the useRealtime bug even before the underlying fix ships (but the useRealtime bug still needs fixing for other flows).

app/(tabs)/index.tsx:32 — greeting is computed once on component mount via IIFE; if the user leaves the app open across a time-of-day boundary the greeting won't update. Low priority, matches PRD ('not live-updating during the day').

app/(tabs)/spray.tsx:30 — filtering `all.filter(j => j.status === 'planned')` after fetching everything is fine at low volumes but should ideally be a repo.sprayJobs.planned() method for parity with active()/completed().

rca_of_issue:
Bug: Save-as-Planned crashes the Spray tab with 'cannot add postgres_changes callbacks for realtime:rt-spray_jobs_spray_job_products-<uuid> after subscribe()'.

Reproduction: guaranteed after tapping save-planned-btn on /records/new (any state — with or without a pre-existing active job).

Root cause: /app/frontend/src/lib/realtime.ts:37 constructs a deterministic channel name `rt-${tables.join('_')}-${businessId}` and does `supabase.channel(name).on('postgres_changes', ...).subscribe()`. When SprayHub is unmounted and remounted quickly (router.replace('/spray') from records/new), the cleanup `supabase.removeChannel(channel)` from the previous mount has not resolved by the time the new mount executes `supabase.channel(name)`. The realtime client returns the previously cached channel — which is already in the `subscribed` state — and the subsequent .on() call throws inside RealtimeChannel.on(). The error propagates out of the effect body into the ErrorBoundary at RootLayout, replacing the entire Spray tree with the 'Something went wrong' screen. Because savePlanned() calls router.replace BEFORE awaiting realtime cleanup, the collision is deterministic.

Mitigation options (recommended: option 1):
  1. Append a per-mount random suffix to the channel name — makes each mount its own channel and the cleanup becomes fire-and-forget (Supabase will GC eventually).
  2. Use useRef to persist a single channel across renders and only recreate it when businessId/tables actually change.
  3. Await removeChannel in cleanup (React doesn't support async cleanup natively — you'd need to store a promise and await inside a state-guarded next-mount).
  4. Change savePlanned() to router.back() instead of router.replace('/spray') AS A TEMPORARY WORKAROUND — this avoids remounting SprayHub but leaves the underlying useRealtime bug open for other flows (e.g. any future router.replace to a tab, deep-link nav, tab-switch race).
